title: Beetroot: modeled ₹1,406/qtl left, Kayamkulam → Chala
summary: January 2022: reported beetroot prices at Kayamkulam and Chala imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 86% of 21 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,406 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 242 same-variety market pairs screened for beetroot in January 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Chala report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2022
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam (Kerala) and Chala (Kerala) both reported beetroot prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 21 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam reported a median ₹6,000 per quintal. Chala reported a median ₹9,028 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹2,428/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹2,428 per quintal, and Chala was dearer on 86% of days.

scenes.headline: 107 km by road
scenes.caption: 107 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹23/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,596 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹1,136 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Chala report, the rule selects 21 of 21 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,406 per quintal (₹997 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Beetroot route from Kayamkulam to Chala was positive on 86% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹140,600, or ₹99,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to beetroot
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹23/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Beetroot route from Kayamkulam to Chala was positive on 86% of matched days in January 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹140,600, or ₹99,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
